ns2:course.label: Ed Prac in Elementary Ed
ns2:course.description: (ED PR 232) Course in practice teaching to meet certification requirements for teaching in the elementary school. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: CI 420, or CI 406 as required by the student's curriculum; Satisfactory completion of all requirements of the Council on Teacher Education Undergraduate or Graduate Common Assessment Plan for Initial Certification (http://www.ed.uiuc.edu/cte/cap).
